Poorly selective, low-magnitude neuron: its top activations are on ordinary mid-sentence function words (" part", " the", " such") and on word-initial sub-word fragments that begin a longer multi-token word (" se"|awater, "-inst"|alled, " Ann"|alise), while very similar tokens in other contexts (" there", "-t"ails, "Res"idential, " Se"uss) drive it strongly negative — i.e. it tracks fine-grained token/continuation context rather than any coherent concept.
